```lean
theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [Finite ι] {s : ι → Set α} (hs : Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint s)) : (⋃ i, s i).encard = ∑ᶠ (i : ι), (s i).encard := by
  induction ι using finite_induction with
  | empty =>
    simp [encard_empty, sum_finite_empty]
  | insert i s h =>
    have h_disj : Disjoint (s i) (⋃ j ∈ s, s j) := hs i s
    have h_union : (⋃ i', s i').encard = (s i).encard + (⋃ j ∈ s, s j).encard :=
      Set.encard_union_eq h_disj
    rw [h_union, sum_finite_add h]
    exact calc
      (s i).encard + (⋃ j ∈ s, s j).encard = (s i).encard + ∑ᶠ (j : ι), (s j).encard
      by rw [h, add_comm]
```
